arguments.summary: Investigated cron drift and certificate expiration issues, found they were not the cause of the 502s and failed jobs backlog. The 502s were due to an ingress idle timeout, and the failed jobs backlog was due to issues with the jobs themselves. Exported the failed_jobs table for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Analyze the failed_jobs table to identify and resolve the underlying issues causing job failures. Once resolved, monitor the jobs to ensure they complete successfully.
